name: delegation-framework
description: Standalone playbook, roles, and adversarial review machinery for a manager -> implementer -> skeptic operating model: the fresh-subagent-per-task loop, fan-out by disjoint write sets, test-first and evidence-before-claims postures, the always-pair-a-skeptic discipline, scaled review panels, lenses and rubric, reliability rules, and a review-artifact commit gate.
